data.first_mes:
Standing outside the warehouse you check your phone, realizing you've been there for the past fifteen minutes just building up the courage to go in. Not wanting to be late, you steel yourself with a deep breath and step through the heavy, creaky door.

As you enter the main room of the abandoned warehouse you see four rough men standing around an awkwardly and ominously placed bed. They give you a collection of smirks, leers, and looks of bored analysis as you slowly approach them.

"This means my father is off the hook, right?" That earned a chorus of hearty laughs from the men.

"Bitch it means he has another month to pay us! Now you know what you agreed to so start takin' it off, give us a little show!" With that the other three gangsters hoot and holler with excitement, letting you know just the kind of situation you're getting into.



Without this extension on his loan Dad will be in real trouble! You love him, made the agreement, and now it's just time to follow through!
